description: This file defines a set of functions and callbacks for handling JSON data within a CMake build system. It includes functions for beginning and ending JSON objects and arrays, handling key-value pairs, literals, and delegating JSON processing. The code sets up a JSON callback table and provides a main 'json' function to process JSON data with a callback mechanism.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Main function to process JSON data, initializes context, sets up callback, and delegates JSON processing.

methods.name: json_obj_begin
methods.description: Callback to start a JSON object, appends '{' to the current JSON string.

methods.name: json_obj_end
methods.description: Callback to end a JSON object, appends '}' to the current JSON string.

methods.name: json_array_begin
methods.description: Callback to start a JSON array, appends '[' to the current JSON string.

methods.name: json_array_end
methods.description: Callback to end a JSON array, appends ']' to the current JSON string.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_begin
methods.description: Callback for beginning a key-value pair, converts key to JSON string and appends 'key:' to the current JSON string.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_end
methods.description: Callback for ending a key-value pair, appends a comma if more pairs follow.

methods.name: json_array_element_end
methods.description: Callback for ending an array element, appends a comma if more elements follow.

methods.name: json_literal
methods.description: Handles JSON literals like null, true, false, or numbers/strings, converting and appending them to the current JSON string.
